translations.web: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.
translations.bsb: If you see your brother’s ox or sheep straying, you must not ignore it; be sure to return it to your brother.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not see thy brother's ox or his sheep go astray, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt in any case bring them again unto thy brother.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not see thy brother's ox or his sheep go astray, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt surely bring them again unto thy brother.
